287349
echo "===== 部署优化 song_request.py 287349 $(date '+%F %T') ====="
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d | gzip -d > /root/bot/bot/plugins/song_request.py.new
/root/bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile /root/bot/bot/plugins/song_request.py.new && echo "语法OK" || { echo "语法失败,中止不覆盖"; rm -f /root/bot/bot/plugins/song_request.py.new; exit 1; }
NEWMD5=$(md5sum /root/bot/bot/plugins/song_request.py.new | cut -c1-8)
echo "新md5=$NEWMD5 (期望 50c433dc)"
if [ "$NEWMD5" = "50c433dc" ]; then
  mv /root/bot/bot/plugins/song_request.py.new /root/bot/bot/plugins/song_request.py
  echo "已覆盖 song_request.py"
else
  echo "md5不符,中止不覆盖"
  rm -f /root/bot/bot/plugins/song_request.py.new
fi
echo "=====完====="
